questions.question: 制造商为“示例机械C”的设备，其停机总时长是多少小时？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."duration_hours") FROM "fact_downtime" f JOIN "dim_equipment" p ON f."equipment_id" = p."equipment_id" WHERE p."manufacturer" = '示例机械C'

questions.question: 月度安全审计的安全审计次数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_safety_audit" WHERE "audit_type" = '月度安全审计'

questions.question: 有多少条培训类型为新员工三级安全教育的安全培训记录？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_safety_training" WHERE "training_type" = '新员工三级安全教育'

questions.question: 哪个部门的费用报销总金额最高？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."dept_name" FROM "fact_expense" f JOIN "dim_department" p ON f."dept_id" = p."dept_id" GROUP BY p."dept_id", p."dept_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."amount") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 2025年发生的所有事故的平均财产损失是多少元？
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG("property_loss") FROM "fact_incident" WHERE substr("incident_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 2025年退货数量（吨）的平均值是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG("quantity") FROM "fact_return" WHERE substr("return_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 制造商为“示例机械D”的设备，其固定资产的折旧记录一共有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_depreciation" f JOIN "dim_fixed_asset" p ON f."asset_id" = p."asset_id" JOIN "dim_equipment" q ON p."equipment_id" = q."equipment_id" WHERE q."manufacturer" = '示例机械D'

questions.question: 2025年的收款金额合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM("amount") FROM "fact_payment" WHERE substr("payment_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 按退货原因统计各自的退货单数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT "reason", COUNT(*) FROM "fact_return" GROUP BY "reason"

questions.question: 特种工程塑料车间发生了多少起事故？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_incident" f JOIN "dim_production_line" p ON f."line_id" = p."line_id" JOIN "dim_workshop" q ON p."workshop_id" = q."workshop_id" WHERE q."workshop_name" = '特种工程塑料车间'

questions.question: 哪台设备累计的维护工时（小时）最高？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."equipment_name" FROM "fact_maintenance_record" f JOIN "dim_equipment" p ON f."equipment_id" = p."equipment_id" GROUP BY p."equipment_id", p."equipment_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."labor_hours") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 哪条产线的OEE合计最高？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."line_name" FROM "fact_equipment_runtime" f JOIN "dim_production_line" p ON f."line_id" = p."line_id" GROUP BY p."line_id", p."line_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."oee") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 订单状态为“delivered”的销售订单，对应有多少张发票？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_invoice" f JOIN "fact_delivery" p ON f."delivery_id" = p."delivery_id" JOIN "fact_sales_order" q ON p."order_id" = q."order_id" WHERE q."status" = 'delivered'

questions.question: 2025年评估日期中，需要控制的风险评估合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM("control_needed") FROM "fact_risk_assessment" WHERE substr("assess_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 合金挤出2线的计划达成率合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."plan_achievement") FROM "fact_production_plan" f JOIN "dim_production_line" p ON f."line_id" = p."line_id" WHERE p."line_name" = '合金挤出2线'

questions.question: 制造商为“示例机械D”的设备所采集的物联网数据条数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_iot_data" f JOIN "dim_sensor" p ON f."sensor_id" = p."sensor_id" JOIN "dim_equipment" q ON p."equipment_id" = q."equipment_id" WHERE q."manufacturer" = '示例机械D'

questions.question: 2026年的维护计划中，下次维护日期的间隔天数合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM("interval_days") FROM "fact_maintenance_plan" WHERE substr("next_date",1,4) = '2026'

questions.question: 传感器类型为“温度”的告警中，已处理的告警合计有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."is_handled") FROM "fact_alarm" f JOIN "dim_sensor" p ON f."sensor_id" = p."sensor_id" WHERE p."sensor_type" = '温度'

questions.question: 费用类型为“市场推广费”的报销单有多少笔？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_expense" WHERE "expense_type" = '市场推广费'

questions.question: 制造商为“示例机械E”的设备所对应的传感器，一共产生了多少条IoT数据？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_iot_data" f JOIN "dim_sensor" p ON f."sensor_id" = p."sensor_id" JOIN "dim_equipment" q ON p."equipment_id" = q."equipment_id" WHERE q."manufacturer" = '示例机械E'

questions.question: 状态为“open”的应付账款有多少笔？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_ap" WHERE "status" = 'open'

questions.question: 哪个传感器的测量值合计最高？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."sensor_name" FROM "fact_iot_data" f JOIN "dim_sensor" p ON f."sensor_id" = p."sensor_id" GROUP BY p."sensor_id", p."sensor_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."value") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 合作起始日期为2015-02-01的供应商，其采购订单行一共有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_po_line" f JOIN "fact_purchase_order" p ON f."po_id" = p."po_id" JOIN "dim_supplier" q ON p."supplier_id" = q."supplier_id" WHERE q."cooperation_since" = '2015-02-01'

questions.question: 测量单位为 kg 的传感器所对应的告警中，已处理的告警合计有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."is_handled") FROM "fact_alarm" f JOIN "dim_sensor" p ON f."sensor_id" = p."sensor_id" WHERE p."unit" = 'kg'

questions.question: IoT数据中，按数据质量分组，各有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT "quality_flag", COUNT(*) FROM "fact_iot_data" GROUP BY "quality_flag"

questions.question: 应付金额合计最高的供应商名称是什么？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."supplier_name" FROM "fact_ap" f JOIN "dim_supplier" p ON f."supplier_id" = p."supplier_id" GROUP BY p."supplier_id", p."supplier_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."amount") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 2026年，银行账号为 SYN-ACCOUNT-0003 的付款笔数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_payment_out" WHERE substr("payment_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "bank_account" = 'SYN-ACCOUNT-0003'

questions.question: 最近交易日期为2025年7月4日的客户，其销售订单的指导价合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."guide_price") FROM "fact_sales_order" f JOIN "dim_customer" p ON f."cust_id" = p."cust_id" WHERE p."last_deal_date" = '2025-07-04'

questions.question: 哪个车间的用水量合计最高？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."workshop_name" FROM "fact_energy_consumption" f JOIN "dim_workshop" p ON f."workshop_id" = p."workshop_id" GROUP BY p."workshop_id", p."workshop_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."water_tons") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 产品线名称为“ABS/PC合金系列”的库存记录数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_inventory" f JOIN "dim_product" p ON f."prod_id" = p."prod_id" JOIN "dim_product_line" q ON p."prod_line_id" = q."prod_line_id" WHERE q."prod_line_name" = 'ABS/PC合金系列'

questions.question: 2025年的退货数量合计是多少吨？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM("quantity") FROM "fact_return" WHERE substr("return_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 2025年的平均报销金额是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG("amount") FROM "fact_expense" WHERE substr("expense_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 2026年发生且状态为“closed”的事故有多少起？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_incident" WHERE substr("incident_date",1,4) = '2026' AND "status" = 'closed'

questions.question: 原因类别为“工艺”的停机总时长是多少小时？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."duration_hours") FROM "fact_downtime" f JOIN "dim_downtime_reason" p ON f."reason_code" = p."reason_id" WHERE p."category" = '工艺'

questions.question: 哪个成本中心的实际金额合计最高？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."cc_name" FROM "fact_budget" f JOIN "dim_cost_center" p ON f."cc_id" = p."cc_id" GROUP BY p."cc_id", p."cc_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."actual_amount") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 销量目标合计最高的员工姓名是什么？
questions.SQL: SELECT p."emp_name" FROM "fact_sales_target" f JOIN "dim_employee" p ON f."emp_id" = p."emp_id" GROUP BY p."emp_id", p."emp_name" ORDER BY SUM(f."sales_quantity_target") DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: 联系电话为“072-4973785”的供应商，其采购订单的总金额合计是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."total_amount") FROM "fact_purchase_order" f JOIN "dim_supplier" p ON f."supplier_id" = p."supplier_id" WHERE p."contact_phone" = '072-4973785'

questions.question: 制造商为“示例机械E”的设备产生的告警中，已处理的告警合计有多少条？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(f."is_handled") FROM "fact_alarm" f JOIN "dim_equipment" p ON f."equipment_id" = p."equipment_id" WHERE p."manufacturer" = '示例机械E'

questions.question: 银行账号为 SYN-ACCOUNT-0004 的付款笔数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_payment_out" WHERE "bank_account" = 'SYN-ACCOUNT-0004'

questions.question: 2025年的天然气总用量是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM("gas_m3") FROM "fact_energy_consumption" WHERE substr("record_date",1,4) = '2025'

questions.question: 有多少个采购订单的状态是“closed”？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_purchase_order" WHERE "status" = 'closed'

questions.question: 产品线名称为“特种工程塑料系列”的销售订单数是多少？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_sales_order" f JOIN "dim_product" p ON f."prod_id" = p."prod_id" JOIN "dim_product_line" q ON p."prod_line_id" = q."prod_line_id" WHERE q."prod_line_name" = '特种工程塑料系列'

questions.question: 位置描述为“青岛一厂B栋”的车间里，事故一共发生了多少次？
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "fact_incident" f JOIN "dim_production_line" p ON f."line_id" = p."line_id" JOIN "dim_workshop" q ON p."workshop_id" = q."workshop_id" WHERE q."location" = '青岛一厂B栋'
